video.script: Every morning, six people post standups. Nobody reads them. Critical blockers hide in the middle of the thread and stay stuck until Friday. This tool kills that loop. Paste the entire thread, it extracts the escalations, spots the trends, and tells you who's about to burn out. Runs in your browser, no setup. Link in the description.
